items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Is she related to Miss LeBreton? ... Well, that's her sister.

ctx.x: I've been in that family since her sister, which is dead now, was 14 years old.
Is she related to Miss LeBreton? Huh? Is she related to Miss LeBreton? Who? Gladys Ranshaw?
Well, that's her sister. I see.
